statement: Pre-flight setup is correct: board alignment yaw 0 (front arm forward), motor order and directions, angle mode on a switch
note: Betaflight Configurator, props OFF: Motors tab - spin each motor and check position and direction against the build guide; Setup tab - tilt the quad and check the model follows (board alignment yaw = 0: the board's arrow points forward, along its front arm). Pass: all four correct.
rationale: A wrong board alignment flips the quad on its first takeoff; this is the most common first-flight failure.
